_comment: Same experiment as rotation_dirichlet.json, sized for an Apple-silicon laptop (~5-7h, run it overnight with `caffeinate -dimsu`). Differences from the GPU config: subset_analysis is off (15 subsets x 4 rotations x 10k images is the single most expensive step, and it can be recomputed later from the saved models), and eval_every is sparser. Delivers ~8,000 gradient steps per expert, which is the threshold below which the accuracy table is meaningless - see REPORT.md 10.3.
